title: Integer Parameter Shifts in One-Variable Restrictions of Lauricella's $F_C$
summary: We construct rational functions of the coefficient index for one-variable restrictions of Lauricella's function $F_C$ at arguments related by cube roots of unity, with arbitrary integer differences among the lower parameters. We express the product coefficients in each residue class as these rational functions times the coefficients of Henrici's known triple product.
